$comment: doctrina verify runs each check in order. Phase 0 has no code, so the checks are documentation gates; the BlocksDS build and the parity tests join here in M1/M3.

checks.name: links
checks.run: python3 -c "import re,pathlib,sys;bad=[(str(f),l) for f in list(pathlib.Path('.').glob('*.md'))+list(pathlib.Path('docs').glob('*.md')) for l in re.findall(r'\]\(((?!https?:)[^)#]+)',f.read_text()) if not (f.parent/l).exists()];print('broken links:',bad) if bad else print('links ok');sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
